🇬🇧 British special forces' K3 Scout reconnaissance drones were found to be fitted with Chinese-made cameras secretly transmitting data back to China, The Telegraph reports, citing sources.

The special forces watercraft were intended for planned operations in the Persian Gulf and entered British service in March. The drones were supplied by major British defense contractor Kraken Technology Group, which had sourced the cameras from a third party that had provided security guarantees.

The K3 drones were part of a future defense package Britain was offering to help secure "freedom of navigation" in the Strait of Hormuz.

All internet connections to the cameras were severed once the leak was discovered.

The paper notes this deepens concerns that Beijing is attempting to spy on the British armed forces.
